accounting: Final metrics are collected from each complete actual journal, including common preparation once. Partial progress is not a final score; accrued costs already include recorded costs. Forecast scores are never summed. Search time is separate from security CPU and does not advance simulated time.
interpretation: Rule baselines perform no search and have no COMPLETE search certificate. Next and Multi use the same exact solver, constraints, actions and tie-break; only the visible horizon differs. COMPLETE certifies a finite nominal horizon search, not a globally optimal receding policy. Selected orbital windows are geometric inputs, with synthetic finite traffic and security parameters. No hardware, attack or compromise-risk claim.
